analysis_trace: Trial NCT06614725 is a Phase 3 study of RSVPreF3 OA vaccine in Indian older adults (60+) and at-risk adults (50-59). Primary endpoints are RSV-A/B neutralizing titers at baseline and 1 month post-vaccination. Secondary endpoints are solicited local/systemic AEs (4 days), unsolicited AEs (30 days), SAEs and pIMDs (6 months).

RSVPreF3 OA is GSK's AS01E-adjuvanted prefusion F protein RSV vaccine, approved in multiple countries based on AReSVi-006 Phase 3 trial showing 82.6% efficacy against RSV-LRTD in adults 60+. The vaccine uses a stabilized prefusion F antigen with AS01E adjuvant.

Evidence from AReSVi-006 and related studies shows robust immunogenicity: RSV-A GMT ratio ~12-14x vs placebo at Day 31, RSV-B GMT ratio ~13-15x. Seroresponse rates >90%. This provides strong anchor for primary-1 and primary-3 predictions.

Safety profile from Phase 3 data: solicited local AEs ~60-70% (pain most common), solicited systemic AEs ~40-50% (fatigue, headache, myalgia). Unsolicited AEs ~20-25%, SAEs ~5-8% (balanced between groups), pIMDs rare (<1%).

India-specific data unavailable as of cutoff. Trial likely started 2024 given NCT number recency. No results posted by 2026-01-31. Predictions rely on global Phase 3 evidence with geographic extrapolation uncertainty.

Primary-0 and primary-2 (baseline titers) are descriptive immunogenicity measures without formal hypothesis testing. Endpoint type 'not_evaluable' in contract suggests these are reference values, not success criteria. Predicted as descriptive.
Primary-1 and primary-3 measure post-vaccination neutralizing titers. Based on AReSVi-006 immunogenicity subset data, expect GMT ratios ~12-14x vs placebo for RSV-A and ~13-15x for RSV-B at Day 31.
Secondary-4 and secondary-5 predict solicited AE rates based on established safety profile. Expect local AEs ~65%, systemic AEs ~45% in vaccine group.
Coverage gaps: No India-specific efficacy/immunogenicity data; no NCT06614725 results; no age 50-59 subgroup-specific data; AS01E adjuvant safety in Indian population uncharacterized.
Key risks: Geographic immunogenicity variation, older adult immune senescence in 60+ Indian population, potential enhanced safety signals in 50-59 at-risk group.

Trial NCT06614725 evaluates RSVPreF3 OA vaccine (GSK's Arexvy) in Indian older adults (≥60) and adults 50-59 at increased risk. Searches retrieved multiple Phase 3 studies (2024) confirming established safety profile in similar populations, but full-text fetch failed (not_fetchable). Registry lookup also failed (HTTP 403).

Unsolicited AEs (secondary-6): Prior Phase 3 data (e.g., Clin Infect Dis 2024; J Infect Dis 2024) show 30-40% of vaccine recipients experience unsolicited AEs within 30 days vs 20-30% placebo. AS01E adjuvant increases local/systemic reactogenicity but events are mostly mild/moderate.

SAEs (secondary-7): Historical Phase 3 data over 6 months show SAE rates of 4-8% with no imbalance between vaccine and placebo groups. No vaccine-related serious safety signals identified in prior trials of this vaccine in older adults.
pIMDs (secondary-8): Potential immune-mediated diseases are rare (<1% in prior trials) with no consistent pattern suggesting vaccine causation. Expected rate 0.1-0.5% in both groups.

Coverage gaps: Cannot access full text of identified Phase 3 studies (39099085, 38981954, 39052726) due to fetch restrictions; registry details unavailable; specific India population safety data not directly accessible. Forecasts extrapolate from global Phase 3 evidence.

Key risks: Population differences between global trials and India cohort; co-administration with other vaccines not specified in available context; limited data on 50-59 at-risk subgroup vs ≥65 population from retrieved sources.

Evidence role: Indirect_direction for all three endpoints. Same vaccine, same indication, similar population (older adults), different geographic regions. Numeric_use_allowed: Range estimates only, not exact values.

matches.human_readable_report: NCT06614725 是 GSK RSVPreF3 OA（AS01E 佐剂预融合 F 蛋白）疫苗在印度人群的 3 期免疫原性桥接研究，覆盖 60 岁以上口服（OA）队列与 50-59 岁有基础疾病（AIR）队列，gold_reference 按 OG000 OA-RSV / OG001 OA-Placebo / OG002 Adults-AIR-RSV / OG003 Adults-AIR-Placebo 四组报告。kimi 模型对全部 9 个终点（primary-0 至 secondary-8）给出 predicted 输出。核心数值发现是量级失准：模型预测基线 RSV-A GMT 200.0（CI 150.0-250.0）、RSV-B 180.0（CI 130.0-230.0），而 Gold 基线四组分别为 1210.0/1316.7/1255.0/1105.3（RSV-A）与 1561.3/1571.0/1579.1/1548.4（RSV-B），低估约 83%-88%，CI 完全不覆盖任一 Gold 组；Day 31 疫苗组绝对 GMT 2600.0/2500.0 对 Gold 10777.9/14982.7（OG000/OG002）低估约 76%-79%，而比值 13.0/14.0 反而高于 OA 队列实际比值 8.3/6.9。方向层模型表现较好：8/9 终点组间方向正确，包括疫苗组征集部位事件多于安慰剂组（与 Gold 126 对 36、109 对 36 的计数方向一致）、SAE 与 pIMD 无组间失衡（Gold 至 M6 仅 OG002 有 1 例 SAE、pIMD 四组全 0）。结构层主要缺陷是模型全篇只有 RSVPreF3 OA 与 Placebo 两组预测，Adults-AIR 队列的 OG002/OG003 两臂在 9 个终点中系统性缺失；另 primary-2 称 RSV-B 基线略低于 RSV-A，与 Gold 中 RSV-B 1561.3 高于 RSV-A 1210.0 相反。安全终点模型给率（35%/25%、5%/5%、0.2%）而 Gold 为无分母的 Participants 计数，数值口径不可比，按非传播规则仅数值层记 not_evaluable，方向与时间窗仍实际评估。过程侧 audit 显示 11 turns、blocked 8、returned 30、empty 4、max_doc_date 2025-11-19、verdict PASS；检索池混入 EE271/EE613/EE443/EE455 四篇成本效益研究，而真正能定标印度老年人群基线 GMT 的本地血清学证据缺失，模型把 AReSVi-006 全球基线直接迁移为本地预测，uncertainty 字段虽写了 India-specific data unavailable，却仍对基线值给出 probability_endpoint_met 1.0，文字不确定性与数值过度自信相互矛盾。三轴结论：prediction_accuracy 59.2、analysis_quality 71.4、search_quality 63.4，无综合分。该样本的典型失败模式是外部数据迁移未做人群量级校准：方向与机制全对、量级差一个数量级附近。
matches.judge_comments: 对 NCT06614725 的审阅基于 packet 冻结材料。最关键的锚点对照：模型基线 RSV-A GMT 200.0 对 Gold OG000 1210.0（OG001 1316.7、OG002 1255.0、OG003 1105.3），RSV-B 180.0 对 1561.3-1579.1，低估约 83%-88%；Day 31 疫苗组 2600.0 对 OG000 10777.9、OG002 14982.7。次级观察：模型比值 13.0 与 AIR 队列实际 14982.7/1129.5≈13.3 意外接近，但对 OA 队列 10777.9/1304.5≈8.3 高估，说明模型并未真正区分两个队列，只是单一全球锚的巧合命中；secondary-7 Gold 仅 OG002 一例 SAE、secondary-8 四组 pIMD 全 0，模型 no_difference 判断与之相容。检索层 4 篇成本效益研究（EE271/EE613/EE443/EE455）混入而印度本地血清学定标证据缺失，是量级失准的直接过程根源；模型对 MED/41194599（2025-11-05）的使用仅限机制背景，未越 cutoff。按非传播规则，百分比 vs Participants 计数的口径不匹配只在数值层记 not_evaluable，不扩散为整终点弃权；三轴独立评分，无综合分。

endpoint_reviews.reason: 证据：structured_prediction 中 primary-1 为 predicted，GMT ratio 13.0（CI 10.0-16.0），组预测 RSVPreF3 OA 2600.0 / Placebo 200.0，rationale 引 AReSVi-006 "GMT ratio ~12-14x at Day 31"；gold_reference 中 primary-1 四组 Day 31 值 OG000 10777.9、OG001 1304.5、OG002 14982.7、OG003 1129.5。优点与不足：模型比值 13.0 落在 AIR 队列实际比值 13.3 附近且方向正确、外部证据引用明确；但疫苗组绝对 GMT 2600.0 对 OG000 10777.9 低估约 76%，对 OA 队列实际比值 8.3 高估，两组结构漏掉 AIR 分层。评分档位依据：100 - 30（2600.0 对 10777.9 低估约 76%）- 15（未区分 OA 8.3 与 AIR 13.3 两个比值）- 10（漏两臂）= 45。

prediction_value.estimand: RSV-B neutralizing titers at baseline in per-protocol immunogenicity population
prediction_value.uncertainty: No India-specific baseline data; RSV-B titers typically slightly lower than RSV-A in older adults.
prediction_value.rationale: Baseline descriptive measure. RSV-B titers expected slightly lower than RSV-A based on seroprevalence patterns.

gold_value.measure: RSV-B Neutralizing Titers Expressed as GMTs
gold_value.analysis_population: Analysis was performed on the per protocol set(PPS) for RSV-B which included all eligible participants who received the study intervention as per protocol,had RSV-B immunogenicity results pre- and post-dose, complied with blood draw intervals,without prohibited concomitant medication/vaccination and intercurrent conditions that may interfere with immunogenicity.Only participants included in pre-vaccination timepoint and with data available for RSV-B titers at Day1 were included in the analysis.

endpoint_reviews.value_assessment: 严重低估。模型基线 RSV-B GMT 180.0（CI 130.0-230.0），组预测 180.0 / 190.0；Gold 四组基线 RSV-B GMT 为 OG000 1561.3、OG001 1571.0、OG002 1579.1、OG003 1548.4。180.0 对 1561.3 低估约 88%，CI 上限 230.0 不足任一 Gold 组值的六分之一，量级判断错误约 8 倍。
endpoint_reviews.direction_assessment: 基线描述性终点，组间排序可评：模型称 RSV-B 180.0 略低于 RSV-A 200.0（rationale 写 RSV-B titers typically slightly lower）；Gold 中 RSV-B 1561.3 对 RSV-A 1210.0 实际更高而非更低，亚型间相对判断错误。
endpoint_reviews.group_timepoint_assessment: 组与时间点错位同 primary-0：模型两组 vs Gold OG000-OG003 四组，Day 1 基线时间点一致。
endpoint_reviews.reason: 证据：structured_prediction 中 primary-2 为 predicted，GMT 180.0（CI 130.0-230.0），组预测 180.0/190.0，rationale 称 RSV-B titers slightly lower than RSV-A；gold_reference 中 primary-2 四组 Day 1 值 OG000 1561.3、OG001 1571.0、OG002 1579.1、OG003 1548.4。优点与不足：正确识别 RSV-B 基线描述性质与 Day 1 窗；但 180.0 对 1561.3 低估约 88%，且亚型相对关系判断反了（Gold RSV-B 基线高于 RSV-A），又漏 AIR 两臂。评分档位依据：100 - 45（低估约 88%）- 15（RSV-B 低于 RSV-A 的判断与 Gold 相反）- 10（漏 OG002/OG003）= 30。

prediction_value.estimand: RSV-B neutralizing titers at Day 31 post-vaccination vs placebo
prediction_value.uncertainty: AReSVi-006 showed RSV-B GMT ratio ~13-15x. India variation possible.
prediction_value.rationale: Post-vaccination RSV-B titers. Vaccine generates robust neutralizing responses against both RSV-A and RSV-B subtypes.

gold_value.measure: RSV-B Neutralizing Titers Expressed as GMTs
gold_value.timepoint: At Day 31 (1 month post-study intervention administration)
gold_value.analysis_population:
Analysis was performed on the PPS for RSV-B.
Only participants included in both pre-vaccination and 1-month post vaccination timepoints and with data available for RSV-B titers at 1-month post dose were included in the analysis.

endpoint_reviews.value_assessment: 绝对值严重低估、比值偏高。模型 GMT ratio 14.0（CI 11.0-18.0），组预测疫苗组 2500.0 / Placebo 180.0；Gold Day 31 RSV-B 为 OG000 11834.9、OG001 1721.1、OG002 15846.5、OG003 1398.4。2500.0 对 11834.9 低估约 79%；实际比值 OG000/OG001≈6.9、OG002/OG003≈11.3，模型 14.0 对两个队列比值均高估。
endpoint_reviews.direction_assessment: 方向正确。模型预测疫苗组 RSV-B 应答显著高于 Placebo（higher_is_better）；Gold OG000 11834.9 对 OG001 1721.1、OG002 15846.5 对 OG003 1398.4，方向成立。
endpoint_reviews.group_timepoint_assessment: 两组预测 vs Gold 四组（OA/AIR 两队列），Day 31 时间点一致；模型未覆盖 OG002 15846.5 与 OG003 1398.4 所在 AIR 队列。
endpoint_reviews.reason: 证据：structured_prediction 中 primary-3 为 predicted，GMT ratio 14.0（CI 11.0-18.0），组预测 2500.0/180.0，rationale 引 AReSVi-006 "RSV-B GMT ratio ~13-15x"；gold_reference 中 primary-3 四组 Day 31 值 OG000 11834.9、OG001 1721.1、OG002 15846.5、OG003 1398.4。优点与不足：方向正确且与 RSV-A 预测内部一致；但 2500.0 对 11834.9 低估约 79%，14.0 高于两个队列实际比值 6.9 与 11.3，CI 11.0-18.0 不覆盖 OA 队列实际比值。评分档位依据：100 - 30（绝对值低估约 79%）- 20（比值对两队列均高估且 CI 偏移）- 10（漏 AIR 两臂）= 40。

prediction_value.estimand: Solicited administration site events within 4 days post-vaccination
prediction_value.uncertainty: Based on AReSVi-006 reactogenicity data. Injection site pain most common (~60%).
prediction_value.rationale: Solicited local AEs expected ~65% in vaccine group vs ~15% placebo, consistent with AS01E-adjuvanted vaccine profile.

gold_value.measure: Number of Participants Reporting Any Solicited Administration Site Events
gold_value.timepoint: From Day 1 (day of administration) to Day 4
gold_value.analysis_population:
Analysis was performed on the Exposed Set, which included all participants who received the study intervention.
Only participants with data available for solicited administration site events at the specified time period were included in the analysis.

endpoint_reviews.value_assessment: 单位口径不可比。模型给百分比 65.0（CI 55.0-75.0）vs Placebo 15.0，denominator 100；Gold 该终点为 "Number of Participants Reporting Any Solicited Administration Site Events"，单位 Participants，无分母行，值含 0/0/0/0 与 126/36/109/36 及 1/1 行，无法折算百分比。模型 65.0% 在 Gold 中无对应口径，数值层面 not_evaluable；若以 OG000 126 人对征集人群的常识分母粗看，量级未必离谱但不可核。
endpoint_reviews.direction_assessment: 方向可评且正确。模型预测疫苗组 65.0% 显著高于 Placebo 15.0%（direction lower_is_better 语境下的组间差）；Gold 非零行 OG000 126 对 OG001 36、OG002 109 对 OG003 36，疫苗组事件人数均高于安慰剂组，组间方向一致。
endpoint_reviews.group_timepoint_assessment: 组与时间点部分错位。模型两组 vs Gold OG000-OG003 四组；时间窗模型 within 4 days post-vaccination 与 Gold "From Day 1 (day of administration) to Da..."（4 天征集窗）一致。
endpoint_reviews.reason: 证据：structured_prediction 中 secondary-4 为 predicted，percentage 65.0（CI 55.0-75.0），组预测 RSVPreF3 OA 65.0 / Placebo 15.0；gold_reference 中 secondary-4 为 Participants 计数行（0/0/0/0、126/36/109/36、1/1），无分母。优点与不足：模型正确预测疫苗组征集部位事件显著多于安慰剂组且方向与 Gold 一致、4 天窗正确；但模型给百分比而 Gold 为参与者计数无分母，数值口径不可比，且漏 Adults-AIR 队列两臂。评分档位依据：数值层 not_evaluable 不折算为模型错误，按方向与结构评估：100 - 25（百分比 vs Participants 计数口径不可比且未声明）- 10（漏 OG002/OG003）- 10（Gold 多行多分级结构未识别）= 55。

prediction_value.estimand: Solicited systemic events within 4 days post-vaccination
prediction_value.uncertainty: Fatigue, headache, myalgia most common. AS01E adjuvant increases systemic reactogenicity.
prediction_value.rationale: Solicited systemic AEs expected ~45% vaccine vs ~20% placebo. Fatigue and headache predominant.

gold_value.measure: Number of Participants Reporting Any Solicited Systemic Events
gold_value.timepoint: From Day 1 (day of administration) to Day 4
gold_value.analysis_population:
Analysis was performed on the Exposed Set.

endpoint_reviews.value_assessment: 单位口径不可比。模型百分比 45.0（CI 35.0-55.0）vs Placebo 20.0；Gold 为 "Number of Participants Reporting Any Solicited Systemic Events"，Participants 计数、无分母，多行按症状分级（如 OG000 47/24 对 OG001、OG002 57/23、OG000 13/5、25/19、17/11 等多组行）。45.0% 无 Gold 对应口径，数值层 not_evaluable。
endpoint_reviews.direction_assessment: 方向正确。模型预测疫苗组 45.0% 高于 Placebo 20.0%；Gold 各症状行中 OG000 系（47/13/25/17）普遍高于 OG001 系（24/5/19/11），OG002 系（57/17/40）高于 OG003 系（23/8/14），疫苗组征集全身事件更多的方向成立。
endpoint_reviews.group_timepoint_assessment: 模型两组 vs Gold 四组；时间窗模型 within 4 days 与 Gold "From Day 1 (day of administration) to Da..." 征集窗一致。
endpoint_reviews.reason: 证据：structured_prediction 中 secondary-5 为 predicted，percentage 45.0（CI 35.0-55.0），组预测 45.0 / 20.0，rationale 称 fatigue 和 headache predominant；gold_reference 中 secondary-5 为多行 Participants 计数（OG000 4、OG001 4、OG002 12、OG003 2、47/24、57/23、13/5、25/19、17/11 等）。优点与不足：方向与症状构成判断（疲劳、头痛为主）合理且与 Gold 行结构相容；但百分比对 Participants 计数口径不可比、Gold 多症状分级行未被识别、漏 AIR 两臂。评分档位依据：100 - 25（口径不可比未声明）- 10（漏 OG002/OG003）- 10（多行分级结构未识别）= 55。

prediction_value.uncertainty: Indirect evidence from global Phase 3 trials; India-specific data unavailable; range estimate due to population and geographic differences

gold_value.measure: Number of Participants Reporting Any Unsolicited AEs
gold_value.timepoint: From Day 1 (day of administration) to Day 30
gold_value.analysis_population:
Analysis was performed on the Exposed Set.
Only participants with data available for unsolicited events at the specified time period were included in the analysis.

endpoint_reviews.value_assessment: 比值口径下方向一致但幅度无法核。模型给 predicted_rate_vaccine 0.35 / placebo 0.25（range 0.25-0.45 与 0.18-0.32）；Gold 为 "Number of Participants Reporting Any Unsolicited AEs" Participants 计数：OG000 12、OG001 5、OG002 14、OG003 3，无分母。模型 35% 对 25% 的绝对水平在 Gold 无分母下不可核；若仅看组间比 12/5=2.4 与 14/3=4.7，模型 0.35/0.25=1.4 的组间比明显低估了实际差值。
endpoint_reviews.direction_assessment: 方向正确。模型 direction 为 higher_in_vaccine，vaccine 0.35 高于 placebo 0.25；Gold OG000 12 对 OG001 5、OG002 14 对 OG003 3，疫苗组非征集 AE 人数更多，方向一致。
endpoint_reviews.group_timepoint_assessment: 模型两组 vs Gold 四组；时间窗模型 within 30 days 与 Gold "From Day 1 (day of administration) to Da..."（30 天非征集窗）一致。
endpoint_reviews.reason: 证据：structured_prediction 中 secondary-6 为 predicted，predicted_rate_vaccine 0.35 / predicted_rate_placebo 0.25（CI 0.3-0.4），rationale 引全球三期 "~30-40% vaccine vs 20-30% placebo within 30 days"；gold_reference 中 secondary-6 四组计数 OG000 12、OG001 5、OG002 14、OG003 3。优点与不足：30 天窗、方向、safety_signal false 的判断与 Gold 相容；但 Gold 无分母使 0.35 的绝对率不可核，组间差距（Gold 12 对 5）被模型的 1.4 倍率低估，且漏 AIR 两臂。评分档位依据：100 - 25（率对计数无分母不可核且未声明）- 15（组间差被低估）- 10（漏 OG002/OG003）= 50。

prediction_value.uncertainty: SAE rates typically balanced across groups in prior trials; 6-month follow-up limited in retrieved sources

gold_value.measure: Number of Participants Reporting Any Serious Adverse Events (SAEs)
gold_value.timepoint: From Day 1 (day of administration) to Month 6 (throughout the study period)
gold_value.analysis_population:
Analysis was performed on the Exposed Set.
Only participants with data available for SAEs at the specified time period were included in the analysis.

endpoint_reviews.value_assessment: 绝对率不可核但零事件结构可核。模型给 SAE 率 vaccine 0.05 / placebo 0.05（range 0.03-0.08）；Gold "Number of Participants Reporting Any Serious Adverse Events (SAEs)" 至 Mo（6 个月）：OG000 0、OG001 0、OG002 1、OG003 0。Gold 实际事件极少（三组 0、一组 1），模型 5% 的预期率在小样本免疫原性亚组下无法换算核对，但其 safety_signal false、serious_signal_present false 的定性判断与 Gold 基本一致。
endpoint_reviews.direction_assessment: 方向正确。模型 direction 为 no_difference（两组均 0.05）；Gold OG000 0 对 OG001 0、OG002 1 对 OG003 0，确无组间失衡证据，方向判断一致。
endpoint_reviews.group_timepoint_assessment: 模型两组 vs Gold 四组；时间窗模型 6 months 与 Gold "From Day 1 (day of administration) to Mo..."（至 M6）一致。
endpoint_reviews.reason: 证据：structured_prediction 中 secondary-7 为 predicted，predicted_rate_vaccine 0.05 / placebo 0.05（CI 0.03-0.07），rationale 引历史三期 "SAE rates of 4-8% over 6 months"；gold_reference 中 secondary-7 四组至 M6 计数 OG000 0、OG001 0、OG002 1、OG003 0。优点与不足：no_difference 方向、6 个月窗、无严重信号判断与 Gold 相符；但 5% 率在 Gold 无分母下不可核，Gold 仅 1 例事件的稀疏结构模型未体现，且漏 AIR 两臂。评分档位依据：100 - 20（率不可核未声明）- 10（稀疏事件结构未体现）- 10（漏 OG002/OG003）= 60。

prediction_value.uncertainty: pIMDs are rare; limited statistical power; specific India population data unavailable

gold_value.measure: Number of Participants Reporting Any pIMDs
gold_value.timepoint: From Day 1 (day of administration) to Month 6 (throughout the study period)
gold_value.analysis_population:
Analysis was performed on the Exposed Set.
Only participants with data available for pIMDs at the specified time period were included in the analysis.

endpoint_reviews.value_assessment: 绝对率不可核但零事件结果吻合。模型给 pIMD 率 0.002（vaccine/placebo 同，range 0.001-0.01）；Gold "Number of Participants Reporting Any pIMDs" 至 M6：OG000 0、OG001 0、OG002 0、OG003 0 全零。模型预期 <1% 的稀有事件判断与 Gold 全零结果方向一致，绝对率在无分母下不可核。
endpoint_reviews.direction_assessment: 方向正确。模型 direction 为 no_difference 且称 pIMDs are rare events；Gold 四组全 0，无组间差异，方向判断一致。
endpoint_reviews.group_timepoint_assessment: 模型两组 vs Gold 四组；时间窗模型 6 months（rationale 基于既有三期随访）与 Gold 至 M6 窗一致。
endpoint_reviews.reason: 证据：structured_prediction 中 secondary-8 为 predicted，predicted_rate_vaccine 0.002 / placebo 0.002（range 0.001-0.01），rationale 称 "pIMDs are rare events (<1%)"；gold_reference 中 secondary-8 四组至 M6 计数全为 0（OG000/OG001/OG002/OG003）。优点与不足：稀有事件定性判断、no_difference 方向与 Gold 全零结果完全相容，confidence 0.55 也算克制；但 0.2% 率在 Gold 无分母下不可核，模型仍漏 AIR 两臂分组。评分档位依据：100 - 15（率不可核未声明）- 10（全零结构未按计数表达）- 10（漏 OG002/OG003）= 65。

endpoint_field_completeness.reason: 证据：structured_prediction 对全部 9 个终点（primary-0 至 secondary-8）均有 predicted 行，含 effect_measure、effect_point、CI、estimand、group_predictions、confidence、rationale；secondary-6/7/8 用 safety 专用字段（predicted_rate_vaccine/placebo、rate_range、safety_signal）。优点与不足：覆盖完整、安全终点字段结构清晰；但全部终点仅两组预测，p_value 普遍缺失。评分档位依据：100 - 15（漏 p_value）- 15（组预测仅两组、四组 Gold 结构未对齐）= 70。

value_accuracy.reason: 证据：模型基线 GMT 200.0/180.0 对 Gold OG000 1210.0/1561.3 低估约 83%/88%；Day 31 疫苗组 2600.0/2500.0 对 10777.9/11834.9 低估约 76%/79%；比值 13.0/14.0 对 OA 队列实际 8.3/6.9 高估；secondary-4/5 百分比对 Participants 计数不可比。优点与不足：免疫应答方向与安全零事件方向均对；但全部四个免疫原性终点的绝对量级偏差 76%-88%，是本批最严重的量级失准之一。评分档位依据：100 - 45（四终点量级低估 76%-88%）- 15（比值对 OA 队列高估）- 5（口径不可比未声明）= 35。

direction_consistency.reason: 证据：模型 primary-1/3 direction higher_is_better 且疫苗组高于 Placebo，与 Gold OG000 10777.9 对 OG001 1304.5、OG002 14982.7 对 OG003 1129.5 一致；secondary-4 至 8 的组间方向均与 Gold 计数行一致；唯 primary-2 称 RSV-B 基线略低于 RSV-A，而 Gold 1561.3 高于 1210.0。优点与不足：8/9 终点方向正确；但 RSV-A/RSV-B 基线相对关系判断反了。评分档位依据：100 - 20（亚型相对关系反向）= 80。

group_timepoint_match.reason: 证据：Gold 全部终点为 OG000 OA-RSV / OG001 OA-Placebo / OG002 Adults-AIR-RSV / OG003 Adults-AIR-Placebo 四组；模型全部终点仅 RSVPreF3 OA 与 Placebo 两组；时间点 Day 1、Day 31、4 天、30 天、6 个月窗均与 Gold 一致。优点与不足：时间窗全部匹配；但 50-59 岁 Adults-AIR 队列两臂在 9 个终点中系统性缺失。评分档位依据：100 - 40（AIR 队列两臂系统性缺失）- 15（OA/AIR 分层设计未识别）= 45。

hallucination_endpoint.reason: 证据：模型 rationale 引 AReSVi-006 "GMT ratio ~12-14x at Day 31" 与 "RSV-B GMT ratio ~13-15x"，这些是 packet 外部的历史试验知识而非编造的本研究数据；终点名称、RSV-A/RSV-B 分型、Day 31 窗均与 Gold measure 一致。优点与不足：外部证据被明确标注来源与不确定性（uncertainty 字段写 India-specific data unavailable）；但把全球数据基线 200-210 直接当作印度人群基线，未提示可能与本地血清暴露史不同。评分档位依据：100 - 15（外部基线直接迁移）- 15（未提示人群差异对量级的影响）= 70。

overconfidence_post_cutoff.reason: 证据：模型对 primary-0/2 基线 GMT 给 probability_endpoint_met 1.0、primary-1/3 给 0.95，confidence 0.7-0.85；packet knowledge_cutoff_post=true、试验结果晚于 2026-01-31 cutoff；而实际基线量级偏差 83%-88%。优点与不足：uncertainty 字段确实写了 geographic uncertainty；但对量级完全失准的基线值给 1.0 概率属于过度自信。评分档位依据：100 - 30（基线值概率 1.0 但低估约 83%）- 15（CI 过窄不覆盖 Gold）= 55。

review_basis.visible_claim: 模型称基线 RSV-A/RSV-B GMT 约 200/180、Day 31 GMT ratio 13/14（疫苗组 2600/2500）、征集部位 65% vs 15%、征集全身 45% vs 20%、非征集 35% vs 25%、SAE 5% vs 5%、pIMD 0.2%。
review_basis.verified_fact: Gold 基线 GMT 实为 1210.0-1316.7（RSV-A）与 1548.4-1579.1（RSV-B），Day 31 疫苗组 10777.9-15846.5；征集/安全终点为 Participants 计数（126/36/109/36 等），四组 OA/AIR 结构模型只覆盖两组。
